title.text: Tasks · Delete List: a deleted list lives in Trash, with its tasks

howto.text:
No Archive any more. ⌘⌫ on a list (or Delete List in its menu) deletes it at once, “Deleted School” with Undo, and it goes to Trash with its tasks. Restoring puts it back in its old place.

Today’s Trash first, then three ways for Trash to hold a list:

A · In the timeline (recommended): one row on the day it was deleted, “11 tasks”, collapsed. Space or the chevron shows its tasks; Return opens it, read-only, with Restore.

B · Lists first: deleted lists in their own group above the days.

C · Previewed: one row; the detail pane lists its tasks.

Winter 2026 and Apartment move were archived; they become deleted lists in Trash on the day they were archived.
